description: Create a new agent session. Wraps `sessions.create`. The default agent id is typically 'main'. Pass an optional `title` to set the human-readable label shown in the Control panel.

agentId.description: Agent id (e.g. 'main'). Defaults to the gateway's default agent if omitted.

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

title.description: Human-readable title shown in the Control panel.

name: openclaw_sessions_create
